extraction.Name: Emma Shangreau
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee and refused to accept it for some time, but took it on the advice of the Superintendent who told her that if she did not take it and keep the taxes up that the land would be sold to pay them
extraction.Recorded patent: she thinks she had the patent recorded but that she is not sure
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged it to Abrahams Loan Co of Omaha, Nebr. for $2000.00
extraction.Buyer: Abrahams Loan Co of Omaha, Nebr. for $2000.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes on her land so she mortgaged it; could not pay the loan so she got a five year extension, which will be up in 1930; has paid the interest and taxes except for the last two years, they being delinquent for that time
extraction.NOTES: Understands most of the English language but does not speak it and can not read nor write it; has a blind husband to support; has not received any aid from the Government, State or County since her patent was issued; all she has is her equity in her land and does not think she will be able to clear it up without aid from the Government; affidavit sworn December 4, 1928; County of Shannon, State of South Dakota
extraction.Literate/Illiterate: does not speak English and can not read nor write it
